sources.name: DEX Screener
sources.note: Exact-pool lookups in batches of up to 30: 127 requests between 2026-11-21 18:12:18 UTC and 2026-11-21 18:13:56 UTC. 1,410 pools returned a matching Uniswap v4 row with a liquidity or volume figure; pools it did not return, or returned without one, are unresolved, not zero. This snapshot asked about 3,483 of the 9,899 pools the collector knows: the pools that answered in the last 72 hours and the pools first seen in the last 72 hours every time, the others in turn (answered 72 hours to 7 days ago: every 3 hours; answered longer ago: every 6 hours; never answered: every 12 hours). The 457 pools GeckoTerminal priced that answered in the last 72 hours are asked about here every 3 hours, and GeckoTerminal is asked about the ones not priced here first in each run, as many as its requests allow. A pool that was not asked is unchecked in this snapshot, not zero. Does not index: Tempo, X Layer.

sources.name: GeckoTerminal
sources.note: Top-pool pages for discovery (pages read: 19) and a small exact-pool fallback (pools measured: 121): 26 requests between 2026-11-21 18:07:23 UTC and 2026-11-21 18:14:57 UTC. Data provided by GeckoTerminal.

sources.name: v4.xyz indexer
sources.note: Pool identity only (which hook, which two currencies) for newly discovered pools: 60 requests between 2026-11-21 18:07:23 UTC and 2026-11-21 18:12:18 UTC. Network lists read: 20, hooked pools listed: 219, exact lookups: 40. It supplies no amounts. The LP fee printed at the end of a pool name is read only to recognise hooks that set fees dynamically.

sources.name: Frontier · pooled coin markets
sources.note: Only isLPd=true markets are included. Curve-only coins are excluded. At most the first 100 coin rows. Fetched successfully from the published source. 10 pooled coin markets listed; Frontier's figures are used for 10 pools of this snapshot (a pool that another provider measured more recently keeps that measurement).

sources.name: Frontier · ETH/USD conversion
sources.note: AMM native-ETH amounts are converted using the current ETH/USD snapshot, not historical execution prices. Curve volume is never counted as v4 volume. Fetched successfully from the published source.

sources.name: Goldsky · Frontier AMM index
sources.note: Pool hooks, core reserves and native-ETH swap amounts. USD fields in this index have no price feed and are not used. Reserve valuation excludes hook-held assets. Fetched successfully from the published source.

sources.name: GeckoTerminal daily volume
sources.note: Complete UTC days up to 20 Nov 2026 for 40 of the largest pools, read 21 Nov 07:50 to 21 Nov 11:29 UTC. Other pools are not covered; a pool with no daily data is unavailable, not zero.

sources.name: Pool census
sources.note: Hook Radar's index of PoolManager events, exported 2026-10-27 21:10:10 UTC. Shown as it stood on 2026-10-27 21:08:49 UTC; this edition does not refresh it. For hooks outside the Uniswap hooklist, whether a hook sets LP fees dynamically comes from this index at that date.
